name: Product Detail
description: Component to display the main section of the Product Detail Page.

attribute_definitions.name: Container class
attribute_definitions.description: Class(es) to add to this component's container for spacing, alignment, etc.

attribute_definitions.name: PDP Image Column Width
attribute_definitions.description: Choose the width of the column containing the main product image (on desktop.) Useful for fine-tuning the PDP layout to account for different image aspect-ratios and amount of product attributes. Only change this if you want to override the default site settings.

attribute_definitions.name: Test Product ID
attribute_definitions.description: This product will be rendered within Page Designer for testing purposes. The default product is 25519349M.
